purpose: Run the repaired TOPA morphology candidate engine on actual public FKt230303 numeric bathymetry without using vent labels as features or tuning thresholds after seeing field ranks.

blindness_class.reason: The investigator has already reviewed published Puy morphology and ROV locations. The benchmark therefore tests frozen algorithmic ranking/generalization, not a pristine investigator-blind discovery trial.

inputs.primary: MGDS FKt230303 processed 1 m bathymetry grids

first_pass_resolution_rule.conversion: derive pixel counts from grid spacing metadata; for a verified 1 m grid this is 128 px / 128 px
first_pass_resolution_rule.reason: Start coarse enough to measure terrain-family specificity before attempting chimney-scale localization.

required_controls: ordinary summit terrain matched by coverage and resolution

promotion_rules.missed_known_vent: counts as a false negative; do not rescue by recentering
promotion_rules.high_scoring_nonvent_geology: counts as a false-positive family and becomes new training memory
promotion_rules.active_vent_label: requires independent plume/direct ground truth; cannot be generated by bathymetry score
